name: vujahday_script
description: Vujaday! That eerie feeling that nothing like this has ever happened before. This script font comes with both a plain and a script stylistic set. Its rough edge adds to the handwritten feel. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/vujahday .
